_comment: App-level demo seed. The app_state document historically carried analyses, cases, reports and feedback but never alerts or exposures, which left the alert console reading fixture data from the browser while its write endpoints persisted to the backend. These records give the backend its own alert and exposure records, matching the same demo scenario, so GET /alerts returns real stored rows that the action endpoints can then update.
